scientific_integrity: The proof uses known almost-sure singleton symbolic coding and establishes new uniform parameter derivative bounds, not independent publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies to affine 3D heterochaos baker maps, two maximal entropy measures and C^r observables; no total variation response or arbitrary continuous-observable differentiability asserted.
title: Smooth parameter response of both maximal-entropy measures in heterochaos baker maps
